description: A process runx supervises apart from any driver: started by one call, and read, written and stopped by later ones until it exits. It belongs to the actor whose run started it.

actor.description: The actor whose runs may read, write and stop it; none for an operator's run.

call.description: The call that started it, as its run names it: `<run id>#<step id>@<attempt>`.

cwd.description: The absolute directory it runs in.

message.description: Why it failed, for a process that never ran or whose supervisor ended without recording its exit.

kind.description: What a process is: one `process.start` detached under a supervisor of its own, or a `command.execute` its driver runs and follows until its call settles. A command takes no input.
kind.title: ProcessKind

max_seconds.description: How long its supervisor lets it run before stopping it.

state.description: Where a process stands: recorded and waiting on its supervisor, running under it, or exited.
state.title: ProcessState

tty.description: The terminal it runs in, when it was given one.
tty.title: TerminalSize

title: RunxProcess
